jobs.title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Acute Care
jobs.description: Provide direct patient care in an acute care environment, administer medications, monitor patient conditions, and collaborate with physicians and healthcare teams.
requirements: Current certificate of registration with the College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO)
Minimum 2 years of acute care clinical experience
Strong critical thinking and communication skills

jobs.title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Community Care
jobs.description: Deliver professional nursing services to patients in community and home care settings, including assessments, medication administration, and care planning.
requirements: Valid CNO license in good standing
Previous experience in home or community healthcare
Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle access

jobs.title: Personal Support Worker (PSW) - Home Care
jobs.description: Provide compassionate personal care and daily living assistance to clients in their homes, including mobility support, hygiene, meal assistance, and companionship.
requirements: Recognized PSW certificate or equivalent personal support credentials
Current First Aid and CPR certification

jobs.title: Personal Support Worker (PSW) - Long Term Care
jobs.description: Support residents in a long-term care environment with personal hygiene, mobility, meals, companionship, and other daily living requirements.
requirements: Experience working within long-term care facilities
Ability to handle physical demands, including bending and lifting
Strong team player with positive communication skills

jobs.title: Fine Dining Server

requirements: Minimum 2 years of fine dining serving experience
Extensive knowledge of food pairings and upscale service etiquette

jobs.title: Banquet Server
jobs.description: Set up banquet spaces, serve food and beverages at events, assist guests, and maintain professional service standards throughout functions.

Ability to carry heavy trays and stand for long periods
Flexible availability for weekend and evening event shifts

jobs.title: Restaurant Wait Staff
